topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When the package arrived, I thought it was for me, a surprise from a friend or maybe something I'd forgotten. But the name on the label was unfamiliar, a hint of a life that once thrived here. I opened the box out of curiosity, half expecting to find something ordinary like kitchenware or books. Instead, it was an old, worn photo album. The pages held memories not mine, faces smiling in places I'd never been. It feels wrong to have stumbled upon these private moments. I'll try to return it, but for now, these images are a bittersweet reminder of what might have been, of connections I'll never know.
